description:
Offline demonstration coupling a high-temperature gas-cooled reactor heat source to a petroleum refinery flowsheet, built from outram-park-fork-dwsim-libs unit operations plus an HTR-10 primary loop.

INTENDED USE: education, research, capability building and V&V only. Offline demonstration, no connection to any operational or plant system. See RESPONSIBLE_USE.md. Nothing here is for facility operation, licensing, or safety-critical decisions.

WHY THIS IS GROUNDED: nuclear process heat for refining is a real, openly published application area — HTR-10 was built in part as a process-heat demonstrator, and the INL/NGNP programme published HTGR-integrated refinery and hydrogen studies. Validation targets therefore exist in open literature at the BLOCK level, though no integrated nuclear-refinery plant exists to validate the whole flowsheet against. See the V&V child.

STARTING CAPABILITY (audited 2026-08-11):
HAVE — outram-park-fork-dwsim-libs carries a refinery-grade thermo layer with zero todo!(): Peng-Robinson/PR1978, PRSV2, Lee-Kesler-Ploecker, Chao-Seader-Grayson hydrocarbon K-values, black oil, sour water, inside-out flash (Boston-Britt), VLLE/LLE/SLE, Gibbs multiphase, and conversion/equilibrium/Gibbs/PFR/CSTR reactors. Also heater, cooler, heat_exchanger, compressor, expander, pump, valve, mixer, splitter, separator, pipe.
MISSING — no distillation column, no crude assay / pseudo-component characterisation, no flowsheet solver with recycle convergence, and no process-heat coupling unit op.

HEAT SOURCE CAVEAT — READ BEFORE CLAIMING ANYTHING: there is NO validated HTR-10 model in this workspace. docs/reactor-scoping/htr10.md (audit 2026-08-06) records that nothing HTR-10-specific is in the repository, the packed-bed Ergun pressure drop is a todo!(), pebble-bed effective radial conductivity has zero code, the solid database has no graphite, and the existing htgr_sim_v1 example is PRISMATIC, not a pebble bed. Do not describe the heat source as validated. This epic must either block on the HTR-10 core work or run against an explicitly labelled surrogate heat source.
title: nuclear oil refinery — HTR-10 process heat into a refinery flowsheet

description:
Closes the loop between the hydrogen plant and the refinery, and gives the hydrogen recycle that makes the flowsheet solver earn its keep.

SCOPE: a conversion or equilibrium reactor block for hydrodesulphurisation duty using the existing conversion_reactor.rs / equilibrium_reactor.rs, fed by makeup hydrogen from the reformer plus a recycle stream, with a separator and recycle compressor closing the gas loop. Sour water and hydrogen sulphide handling can lean on the existing sour_water.rs property package.

Reaction stoichiometry and conversion data must come from open published sources with provenance recorded per DATA_POLICY.md. Kinetics may be lumped — say so in the doc comment rather than implying a mechanistic model.
title: refinery: hydrotreater block consuming the reformer hydrogen

description:
The crate carries two HTR-10 TRISO geometries that differ:
  TrisoSpec::HTR10_LI2014 (pebble_beds/fhr_pebble.rs:113-120) buffer 0.0340 cm - Table 2's 90 um
  TrisoRadii::HTR10      (geometry/triso_particle.rs:111-117) buffer 0.0345 cm - 95 um

A +3.33 percent particle-volume difference, left deliberately unadjudicated (op-0pqu), with an explicit 'do not silently swap one for the other' warning at fhr_pebble.rs:97-112.

Pick one against IAEA-TECDOC-1382 Table 4-17 and SAY WHICH. Must happen before 2.3 builds geometry on top of either.
title: Phase 2.4 PREREQUISITE: adjudicate the two disagreeing HTR-10 TRISO presets

description:
s37. Two distinct, clearly-labelled operations. `:w` / Save Document writes the current canonical markdown buffer to disk and does NOT stage or commit. Save Repository is the friendly abstraction over `git add .` + `git commit`, implemented with gitoxide, producing DETERMINISTIC SEMANTIC commit summaries with NO AI (e.g. 'Added: ORNL-4344 literature record, MSRE topic / Edited: Wang (2018): added 2 annotations, 1 digitised table, 3 wiki links').

UI shows both states separately: 'Document OK Saved' and 'Repository -- 7 changes since last repository save'. Restricted PDFs must be structurally excluded from the staged set (s46), not merely gitignored by convention.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Implemented: src/repository.rs (status/save_repository over gix). Save Document is PaperSession::save_document (op-9vo6.10) -- no staging/commit. Save Repository builds a tree matching the current non-excluded worktree directly via gix::Repository::write_blob/write_object (blobs dedupe by content hash, so unchanged files cost nothing extra) and commits it with a DETERMINISTIC, NO-AI summary (SaveSummary::to_commit_message, s37's Added/Edited/Removed shape) -- author/committer identity is a fixed 'Kovan <kovan@localhost>' set via config_snapshot_mut rather than depending on ambient user.name/user.email, which this determinism requirement itself argues against depending on. is_excluded() hard-skips restricted_sources_dir()/.kovan/.git at the tree-building level -- STRUCTURAL exclusion, not gitignore-convention; test restricted_pdfs_are_never_part_of_the_saved_tree explicitly empties the .gitignore and reconfirms exclusion still holds. status() reads without writing (diffs the built tree against HEAD's, or treats everything as new on an unborn HEAD). 7 tests, all against real gix-backed temp repos (not mocked).

title: kovan redesign 19: Save Document vs Save Repository

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
2026-09-10 (session_01AhE6XBx3nRd81aHLQrciQe): FIRST GOLDEN-FILE VALIDATION of the ported GROUPR engine against a real NJOY2016 GENDF tape - the "top V&V ask" of op-3ut/op-cpz/op-ini is now measured, for the vector (mfd=3) path with the Bondarenko self-shielded flux (nsigz>1).

Oracle: NJOY2016 ac5adf5 (2016.79) built in-session; RECONR(0.001)/BROADR(293.6 K)/GROUPR on ENDF/B-VIII.0 U-238 (MAT 9237), ign=1 (29 user groups 1e-5..2e7 eV), iwt=3 (1/E), lord=0, sigz = 1e10 1e4 1e3 1e2 10 1, MT 1/2/18/102. Golden GENDF (35 KB) + the exact deck committed at reference-data/gendf/ (README with provenance); new accessor reference_data::reference_file("gendf", ..) (+ OUTRAM_PARK_REFERENCE_DATA_DIR override). Test: crates/njoy-outram-park-fork/tests/groupr_u238_gendf_golden.rs (methodology + results in its doc comment).

Upstream read before measuring: getwtf iwt=3 -> wtf=1/e, enext=1.01*e (groupr.f90:5203); genflx nsigz>1 tabulates wtf*(sigpot+sigz)/(sigt+sigz) on the greedy union of 1% steps and the MT=1 grid (:5623-5665), getflx interpolates it lin-lin (:6478-6490); sigpot=0 unless iwt<0 (:4978); lord=0 with nsigz>1 promotes MT=1 to NL=2 (P0+P1, :6498-6499), other MTs stay NL=1; panel = trapezoid flux + rate-linear-across-panel (:5858-6091) == our group_integral. Prediction stated before measuring: <1e-5 with NJOY's own PENDF, O(1e-3) with the crate's RECONR/BROADR.

MEASURED (all 29 groups x 6 sigma0):
 Tier 1, engine isolated on NJOY's own PENDF (env OUTRAM_PARK_NJOY_U238_PENDF; 155,207 sigt points -> 156,864 flux points, NJOY listing: 156,854): max |dsigma_g/sigma_g| = 6.85e-7 (MT=1), 4.55e-7 (MT=2), 2.07e-6 (MT=18), 2.65e-6 (MT=102, group 9, sigma0=inf); max group-flux dev 4.93e-7 (= the 7-significant-figure storage floor). PASS at 1e-5. The group-averaging engine (genflx_bondarenko + panel/group_integral + self_shielded_group_xs) reproduces NJOY.
 Tier 2, crate RECONR(0.001)+BROADR(293.6 K) from the committed ENDF tape (961,139 sigt points; 156 s): max dev 1.98e-4 (MT=1), 1.98e-4 (MT=2), 9.24e-4 (MT=102), flux 6.06e-5 -> PASS at 3e-3. MT=18 1.14e-2 (group 13, 40-50 eV, sigma_f ~2.5e-7 b). Read upstream: reconr.f90:109-117, 428-430 - where a point's resonance-integral contribution is below errint = err/20000 = 5e-8 b, NJOY converges it only to errmax = 10*err = 1 % (NJOY listing: 363,092 points "affected by resonance integral check"). Sub-threshold U-238 fission sits entirely under that floor, so the 1.1 % is NJOY's own linearization slack, not an engine defect (tier 1 shows 2e-6 on MT=18 with NJOY's grid). Asserted at 3e-2 for MT=18, 3e-3 otherwise.

NOT covered (still open): the matrix path (mfd=6 scatter matrices, File-6 feeds, op-ini's port half), URR self-shielding via MT=152 (no UNRESR step in this deck - op-cpz's read_urr_table half), GAMINR, lord>0.

Side findings (filed separately): crate RECONR lacks the errint/errmax resonance-integral relaxation (961k vs NJOY 448k points at the same err); crate BROADR does no thinning (NJOY 448,168 -> 155,207 at errthn=0.001).

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
2026-09-10, later the same session (session_01AhE6XBx3nRd81aHLQrciQe): the MT=152 half is now measured too, and it found a port defect.

Second oracle run: same U-238 deck with `unresr 20 22 24 / 9237 1 6 1 / 293.6 / 1e10 1e4 1e3 1e2 10 1 / 0 /` between BROADR and GROUPR (golden reference-data/gendf/u238-ENDF8.0-293.6K-29g-iwt3-6sigz-unresr.gendf + deck). GROUPR's stounr found MF=2/MT=152 (no "no unresolved sigma zero data" message this time). Rust side: read_urr_from_tape(Some(&pendf), 9237, 1, 293.6) -> UnresolvedTable, fed to self_shielded_group_xs (tier 3 of tests/groupr_u238_gendf_golden.rs, env OUTRAM_PARK_NJOY_U238_UNRESR_PENDF).

Read upstream first: genflx (groupr.f90:5636-5650) sets tot(iz)=sigt(e) for every iz, calls getunr(1,e,en,tot) so that INSIDE the URR tot(iz) becomes the MT=152 self-shielded total for sigz(iz), and only then forms fac=(sigpot+sigz)/(tot(iz)+sigz). Our genflx_bondarenko used the smooth sigma_t.value(e). Predicted before measuring: URR-group flux low by up to ~10 % at sigz=1 b, sigma_g nearly unchanged (second order).

Measured BEFORE the fix: group 22 (20-50 keV) flux at sigz=1 b 6.78 % LOW (ours 0.062356 vs NJOY 0.066892); sigma_g within 1.48e-3 (MT=102, group 22) / 3.43e-3 (MT=18). Sign and size as predicted.
Fix (commit cf9759f1): unresolved::genflx_bondarenko_urr(sigma_t, urr, weight, sigpot, dilutions, grid) shields the total through UnresolvedTable::shield(UrrReaction::Total, ..) per dilution before the Bondarenko factor; genflx_bondarenko is its urr=None wrapper (numerically unchanged, tier 1 re-run identical); self_shielded_group_xs now uses it.
Measured AFTER: sigma_g within 2.65e-6 (MT=102, group 9), 2.07e-6 (MT=18), group flux within 4.93e-7 - the maxima are back in resolved-range groups, i.e. the URR groups agree to NJOY's 7-figure storage floor. groupr:: lib tests 77/77 still pass.

What this validates: read_urr_from_tape (tape-locate + LIST decode), UnresolvedTable::shield (stounr/getunr incl. the LSSF=1 multiplicative combine), and the URR-shielded Bondarenko flux - for U-238 (LSSF=1) at one temperature, six sigz, lord=0. Not covered: LSSF=0 materials, multiple temperatures, lord>0, the flux-calculator (iwt<0) path, the matrix path.

description: Port GeN-Foam multiRegion: field mapping between neutronics/TH/TM meshes. Reuse basic-lib RegionInterface. Needs >=1 neutronics + >=1 TH model.

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content:
Core multiRegion ported + verified in-tree (18 tests pass, release): volumetric meshToMesh (mesh_to_mesh.rs), RBF non-conformal path (rbf_mapping.rs, reuses xs::rbf kernel), coupled-feedback assembly MeshHandler=interpolateCouplingFields (coupling_fields.rs), and the Picard outer loop MultiPhysicsSolver enum-dispatched over RegionModel (outer_iteration.rs) driven end-to-end by 0-D point-kinetics <-> lumped-TH. Scaffolded gaps filed as op-p6p.8.1..8.5 (exact polyhedral meshToMesh, deformMesh, dim-reduced RBF, mesh-based RegionModel dispatch, AABB accel). No shared-file edits needed; no new deps. RBF unification into genfoam::common::rbf flagged.
Mesh-based cross-mesh coupling now realised end-to-end (op-p6p.8.4 closed): MeshNeutronics(DiffusionNeutronics)<->MeshThermalHydraulics coupled through MeshHandler/mesh_to_mesh CellVolumeWeight mapping, with the op-p6p.10 ReactivityFeedback layer supplying the Doppler feedback. Power conserved across non-conformal meshes (rel 2.3e-16), negative Doppler feedback verified on the mesh path. Remaining sub-beads: 8.1 exact polyhedral meshToMesh, 8.2 deformMesh/movePoints, 8.3 dim-reduced RBF, 8.5 AABB accel; plus new follow-up for per-cell/dynamic mesh XS feedback (neutronics-subtree API gap). 24 multi_region tests pass release; Android clean.

title: genfoam: multiRegion cross-mesh coupling

design:
Child epic of the integrated petrochemical and polymer platform (bn op-9941 / see #77 programme).

**Fidelity target: Engineering model**

**The closing loop of the complex**: PTA from the aromatics side, MEG from the olefins side. That makes PET the natural end-to-end conservation test — carbon entering as crude leaving as a single polymer via two independent branches. Polycondensation kinetics differ from chain-growth and will exercise a different subset of the kinetics framework.

Depends on the generic polymer representation, the polymerization kinetics framework and polymer reactors. Validate conversion, Mn, Mw, PDI, product distribution, reactor temperature and productivity against literature benchmarks before treating output as engineering results.

## Programme constraints

No monolithic plant solvers. Reuse existing reaction/thermo/separation infrastructure. Conservation preserved across every representation change. Do not push to `main`.
title: Petchem: PTA / MEG / PET
